name: diverse-project-management
description: DiVerse Industrial Solutions - bid, takeoff and proposal management

scripts.test: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/api.js && node tests/verify-lancaster.js && node tests/estimate-xlsx.js && node tests/smoke.js && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/sync.js

//: No runtime dependencies on purpose. SQLite is node:sqlite, built into Node 22;
the HTTP server and Server-Sent Events are node:http. jsdom and fake-indexeddb
are only needed to run the browser tests: npm install --no-save jsdom fake-indexeddb
tailwindcss is a build-time dependency, not a runtime one: it compiles
assets/tailwind.css, which IS committed. So `node serve.js` on a machine that has
never run npm install still serves a fully styled app. Run npm run build:css after
adding or changing a class name - only what the scanner can see gets shipped.
--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning silences the one notice node:sqlite prints.
It is not silencing anything else, and the flag becomes unnecessary on Node 24
